thread:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Deploy paused: release v2.3.1 -> prod (tag v2.3.1-rc4, commit abcdef12). CI gate failed: 3x unit-test timeouts (suite: payments), e2e queue backlog. Holding deploy until checks pass or manual pin.

amal: Ack, I'm on it. Checking the failing test logs now.

jay: Can we trigger a rerun of the flaky jobs? If it's just timeouts we might be able to unblock with retries.

ci-bot: @jay re-run triggered: jobs rerun ids 9876,9877,9878. ETA ~10m.

tara: Noted the payments suite has been flapping since yesterday after the mock change. I'll triage the failure.

lina: If we need to unblock prod quickly we can pin to last-green (commit 12345678) for the rollout and continue triage in parallel. Thoughts?

amal: prefer pin to last-green for canary only, not full prod. Keep prod hold until canary looks good.

eng-mgr: We need a decision within 30m. If pinning, add release note explaining temporary pin and root cause follow-up.

sre-oncall: If pinning, add a canary with increased monitoring and set error budget alert to 1% for the first hour.

tara: quick log snippet from failing test:
```
FAIL payments_processor_test.go:145: timeout after 30s waiting for mock gateway response
stack: payments/processor.go:78 -> payments/client.go:34
```

amal: reruns returned: job 9876 passed, 9877 failed (timeout), 9878 queued timeout. Still flaky.

lina: ok, proposal: pin canary to 12345678, run canary for 50 requests, rollback if errors > 1%. If canary OK, promote to prod after 30m.

eng-mgr: Agree. @deploy-bot can you open a manual hold and annotate the release notes with the pin decision? Also set rollout to canary first.

deploy-bot: Manual hold applied. Release annotated: "Pin to last-green (12345678) for canary due to Payments test flakiness; triage ongoing." To continue: /deploy promote 12345678 -> canary then /deploy promote -> prod after approval.

ci-bot: CI reruns completed: overall status UNSTABLE (1 failed / 2 passed). Recommend triage continued.

amal: I'll keep investigating causes in the payments mock. Will report by EOD. If someone else wants to help ping me.

jay: I'll update the release channel and add a short note to the release docs.

lina: Thanks team. I'll watch canary metrics once promoted.

sre-oncall: oncall watching. +1 for canary with strict monitoring.

eng-mgr: Decision logged. We'll reconvene in 30m or sooner if canary shows issues. Thanks.
